Round 2 fixes. Built: (1) orchestrator-core carries approval_contract from the digest-verified template (verifyScheduledTemplate refactor; scheduledTemplateContract returns json, sha256 of the compact bytes, and RFC3339 expiry, refusing an expired contract) into ScheduledRunInput, StartScheduledRunActivity (args appended), StartScheduledRunRequest 14-16, ScheduledStepExecutionIntent (via step_loop), and both Control intents; both Control authorizers verify v2 schema, contract digest/expiry match and liveness, and digest with contract fields. v1 bodies and digests unchanged when no contract. (2) user-core: ScheduledRunIntent carries ContractDigest/ContractExpiresAt; execution decision binds them (schema execute-v2); preparation decision only re-checks expiry and stays v1; shared helpers hasScheduledContract/validateScheduledContract/writeScheduledContractBinding in scheduled_step_decision.go. (3) session-core grpc.rs: scheduled_run_contract() checks sha256(contract_json)==contract_digest, RFC3339 expiry and liveness (scheduled_contract_expired), contract fields on ControlSpaceDecisionClaims (serde default), execution decision verifies schema v2 and digest with contract fields and claim match, persist binds contract_digest/contract_expires_at/contract body into immutable run metadata and the exact-match list. (4) execution-core: EXECUTION_CORE_SCHEDULED_CONTRACT_REQUIRED read by strict Some(\"true\") parser (default off); when on, a step decision without contract claims is refused with scheduled_contract_required.

Not built, or built only partly (see depth_findings and lead_todo): ResolveScheduledStepAuthority field values (shared file), the Control HTTP decode of contract fields (unowned file), execution-core wiring of ScheduledStepContext (unowned), session-core tests (cannot link yet), and a Temporal replay test for the new activity args.

Digest definition: contract digest = sha256 of the compact JSON bytes of the approval_contract value as it sits in the digest-verified template. Control (S4) must sign the same definition or the chain refuses.

Without the shared Control decode edit, Control ignores contract fields and issues v1 step/run decisions, so orchestrator refuses contract-bound intents. Fail-closed, not silent.
